cases.input: Replace an old monolithic workflow with a new canonical orchestrator while preserving explicit legacy callers.
requiredBehaviors: migrate active internal consumers before deprecating the old skill
move canonical artifact ownership to exactly one replacement producer
set explicit compatibility lifecycle metadata and a compatibility evaluation
forbiddenBehaviors: remove the old skill while active consumers still depend on it

cases.input: No internal dependents remain, but an unknown external automation may still call the old skill name.
requiredBehaviors: retain a compatibility facade when external consumer status is unknown
keep replacement artifact ownership with the canonical producer
forbiddenBehaviors: assume external consumers do not exist and delete immediately

cases.input: A deprecated skill still has an active consumer and declares the same canonical output as its replacement.
requiredBehaviors: block removal while active consumers remain
remove duplicate canonical output ownership from the facade
migrate the consumer to the replacement first
forbiddenBehaviors: allow duplicate producer ownership during deprecation
